articles.title: E20 petrol meets quality standards, says Govt
articles.description: NEW DELHI, Nov 7: The Government on Saturday defended the 20 per cent ethanol-blended petrol programme, saying tests of 893 samples collected across 27 states and Union Territories, including 56 in Karnataka, found them compliant with prescribed quality standards, as...

articles.title: 31% ethanol charge as Rahul slams ‘petrol chori’
articles.description: The Ministry of Petroleum and Natural Gas on Saturday rejected allegations by the Karnataka Government that petrol sold at some retail outlets contained ethanol levels of 26-31 per cent, asserting that fuel supplied by public sector oil marketing companies (OMCs) across the country conforms to prescribed E20 standards.

articles.title: ‘A lot more bang for your buck’: Used electric vehicles find second wind in Florida amid volatile gas prices
articles.description: In a state where gas hovers around $4 a gallon, skipping the pump sounds like a fantasy, and 54-year-old Paul Gillespie is living that dream.Gillespie’s Chevy Bolt and Rivian R1T are among the over 450,400 registered electric vehicles, or EVs, in Florida. He’s driven an electric car since 2018.

articles.title: Crude Check: Bears make their move
articles.description: Oil prices plunge with a sharp, likely short-lived recovery; Brent near $98 and MCX below ₹9,000, with downside targets to $90 and ₹7,000.

articles.title: Congress leader Udit Raj seeks transparency over alleged ethanol blending above E20
articles.description: Congress leader Udit Raj on Saturday called for transparency in ethanol blending in petrol amid allegations of ethanol blending levels exceeding E20 in Karnataka, saying consumers should not be misled about the composition and pricing of fuel.

articles.title: Now, Keralam too orders checks on petrol ethanol blending
articles.description: Kerala orders inspections at petrol pumps to check excess ethanol blending, with fuel samples to be tested in Thiruvananthapuram, Ernakulam, Kozhikode and Kannur.

articles.title: Ethanol blending: Keralam govt. asks Civil Supplies Commissioner to conduct checks
articles.description: Kerala to inspect ethanol blends in petrol amid reports elsewhere; samples to be tested across four districts, with strict action if excess detected.

articles.title: After Karnataka Charge, Centre Says E20 Petrol Meets Prescribed Standards
articles.description: The 56 samples tested in Karnataka, covering different locations and all three oil marketing companies (OMCs), recorded ethanol content of 19-20 per cent, averaging 19.30 per cent, the oil ministry said.

articles.title: National gas prices drop to $4.03 per gallon for Nov. 7, 2026
articles.description: Prices continue to drop to levels not seen since the end of summer 2026. However, the average price per gallon remains 96 cents higher than it was a year ago.
